replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Occasionally, yes — especially when math feels abstract or rushed. But because I approach it with curiosity rather than pressure, the anxiety is mild and usually tied to fear of misunderstanding, not the subject itself.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I’ve used AI tools to clarify concepts and check solutions. It’s been helpful for quick explanations and visualizations, though I always cross-verify results to ensure accuracy and deepen understanding.
